number.description: Last successful iteration. Does not include the currently running iteration.

finished_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds indicating the last time it finished an iteration.

started_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds indicating the last time it started an iteration.

session.description: OpenCode session ID pointing to the current project's interrogation.

branch.description: Default branch name recorded at init time.

process.description: Ephemeral runtime information for a currently running Ralph loop.

loop_pid.description: PID of the active JRI loop process.

child_pid.description: PID of the currently running OpenCode subprocess, if any.

log_path.description: Path to the current Ralph log file.

detached.description: Whether the loop was launched in detached mode.

active_attempt.description: The currently active task attempt, if a run is in progress or final bookkeeping is pending.

attempts.description: Execution-attempt journal for Ralph task runs.
